AI is not a shortcut to digital transformation.

In fact, adding AI to broken processes often creates faster confusion, not better decisions.

I see many companies rushing to implement AI while still struggling with basic operational challenges.

The signs are easy to spot:

❌ Data lives in multiple Excel sheets

👉 Time, money, and confidence lost
